'''Talon Raal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She worked as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and a [[Scout/Legends|scout]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing game]] scenario ''[[Hunting the Wyrd]]'', Raal can be sent to accompany the player characters on their mission to find the [[Wyrd]], if they lack sufficient combat skills.
